messages.subject: Re: Order datatable
parts:
I believe that datatables uses a stable sort. So I believe you'd just sort by one variable at a time, going from least-significant to most-significant variable.

On Mon, Jun 13, 2016 at 7:31 AM Carlos Leite <carlosmaga...@gmail.com> wrote:
Is it possible to enable an option to sort a datatable by more than one variable? 
We can do that in a static way, but I want the user to be able to order the table by more than one variable.

Thank's a lot,
Carlos
